Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

environment labels before promotion to production.", "output": "Our distributed tracing infrastructure is overwhelming OpenTelemetry collector nodes during high throughput service load. Please inspect sampler.ts in the telemetry directory and check trace_pipeline.yaml in the collector configuration folder. Our microservices emit W3C trace context headers across hundreds of RPC service boundaries. Under sustained traffic loads trace ingestion volume causes memory exhaustion in collector pods dropping valid diagnostic traces. We must configure the head-based trace sampling rate to 5% and implement tail-based adaptive sampling filters. Furthermore ensure that sampler.ts always samples requests that return HTTP 500-series errors regardless of baseline sample probabilities. Update trace_pipeline.yaml to configure batch processor settings setting send batch size to 8000 spans and timeout to 200 milliseconds. Also configure memory limiter processor settings to trigger hard trace drops when collector memory usage exceeds 85% of pod allocation. Site reliability engineers must verify that span storage retention in ClickHouse preserves sampled traces for 30 days with Snappy block compression. To reduce network egress costs collectors must compress exported span payloads using Zstandard compression level 3 before streaming to remote storage. High-frequency health check endpoints in health_check.ts must be completely excluded from trace generation to eliminate redundant trace noise. The observability lead mandates enforcing semantic conventions for database query attributes redacting all SQL parameter values from database client spans. If an upstream collector agent crashes the local OpenTelemetry SDK buffer in tracer_buffer.ts must buffer up to 5000 spans in memory before dropping telemetry data. In addition trace processing workers must compute p95 and p99 trace duration metrics across 1-minute sliding windows exporting latency percentiles to Prometheus. To maintain trace context propagation across asynchronous message brokers Kafka producers in event_producer.py must inject traceparent headers into all record metadata headers. When distributed services execute database transactions the Postgres client driver must extract trace identifiers and tag query comments with span context for cross-tier query attribution. System administrators must configure OpenTelemetry collector pods with 4 GB of memory limits and 2 virtual CPUs ensuring collector buffers do not experience CPU throttling. The network operations center monitors dropped span ratios on the secondary Grafana dashboard raising critical alerts when span loss exceeds 0.2% of total emitted telemetry. Additionally all exported telemetry streams must route through internal private network endpoints avoiding public internet transit across multi-region cloud deployments. Observability engineers must also configure Prometheus alert rules in alerts.yaml to trigger on-call pages when collector queue utilization exceeds 80% across two consecutive polling intervals. Finally the platform team mandates that all microservices pass automated telemetry integration tests verifying that trace spans contain valid service name and environment labels before promotion to production."}]
